faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Create an account and confirm your email. Explore Mettelo Connect, learning resources or project briefs. You only need to reach 80% saved profile completion when you want to apply to a project.

faqs.question: Do I need a Lab to join the community?
faqs.answer: No. Mettelo Connect brings together updates, questions, project ideas and collaboration posts. You can follow people and discover opportunities without a Lab. Participation does not guarantee employment or payment.

faqs.question: Who can see my profile?
faqs.answer: Members see the details you choose to share. Control visibility and message requests in My profile. Hidden and blocked profiles stay unavailable; education, experience and private account details are not published automatically.

faqs.question: How do I apply and enter a Lab?
faqs.answer: Read a brief, confirm your email and save at least 80% of your profile. Apply with a supported working preference and describe your contribution. Mettelo Lab shows the decision and any preparation steps. Legacy offers still need a response; approval alone does not open a Lab.

faqs.question: How many Labs can I join?
faqs.answer: The current standard allowance is three. Official placements and Connect collaborations share it. Paused Labs, accepted places in preparation and unexpired official offers hold slots. Completed Labs and fully exited memberships do not. Leaving releases a slot after access revocation completes.

faqs.question: What goes into My Portfolio?
faqs.answer: Your contributions, evidenced milestone acceptances, practised skills and confirmed team delivery outcomes. Member-reported work is distinct from reviewed outcomes; neither is an independently verified qualification. Your portfolio stays private unless you explicitly share a selected summary.

faqs.question: How do jobs and learning resources work?
faqs.answer: Explore the Job Board and apply on the employer’s source website. Use the recorded workshops and member Resources to prepare. Check each advert’s deadline, eligibility and sponsorship details.

faqs.question: How do I get help?
faqs.answer: Use My enquiries for private account, application or Lab support, and follow replies there. Or use Contact & Support without an account. Never send passwords, access keys or confidential project data.

faqs.question: Can an organisation partner with Mettelo?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the partnership enquiry form to discuss a project challenge, workshop, mentoring or other collaboration. Explain the organisation, proposed contribution and intended benefit. Enquiring does not create a partnership or project commitment.
